# Full body from PBE (common/diplomatic_actions/vokaes_power_bloc_actions.txt):
#   game-rule-gated possible/accept_effect (live by default, see module docstring)
# plus grey_subject's border check spliced into `possible`

#   text = common_border1) -- the one thing PBE's body does not have.

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:force_become_subject = {
	groups= {
		power_bloc_leader
	}
	show_in_lens = no

	texture = "gfx/interface/icons/diplomatic_action_icons/force_become_subject.dds"
	
	selectable = {
		is_power_bloc_leader = yes
		power_bloc ?= {
			modifier:power_bloc_leader_can_make_subjects_bool = yes
		}		
	}
	
	potential = {
		power_bloc ?= {
			scope:target_country.power_bloc ?= this
		}
	}
	
	possible = {
		scope:target_country = { 
			is_subject = no
			is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = no
			OR = {
				has_game_rule = vokaes_power_bloc_rule_diplo_action_changes_enabled
				country_rank < rank_value:unrecognized_major_power 
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_game_rule = vokaes_power_bloc_rule_diplo_action_changes_enabled
			power_bloc = {
				current_cohesion_percentage >= 0.5
			}
		}
		scope:target_country = {
			tenure_in_current_power_bloc_years >= 5
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				has_game_rule = vokaes_power_bloc_rule_diplo_action_changes_enabled
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = "PRESTIGE_THREE_TIMES_POSSIBLE"
					prestige >= {
						value = scope:target_country.prestige
						multiply = 3
					}
				}
			}
			prestige >= {
				value = scope:target_country.prestige
				multiply = 5
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = common_border1
			scope:target_country = {
				any_scope_state = {
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						OR = {
							owner = ROOT
							owner = {
								OR = {
									has_diplomatic_pact = {
										who  = ROOT
										type = puppet
									}
									has_diplomatic_pact = {
										who  = ROOT
										type = colony
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	
	accept_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_type = unrecognized }
			create_diplomatic_pact = {
				country = scope:target_country
				type = tributary
			}						
		}
		else = {
			create_diplomatic_pact = {
				country = scope:target_country
				type = protectorate
			}			
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_game_rule = vokaes_power_bloc_rule_diplo_action_changes_enabled
			}
			create_incident = {
				country = scope:target_country
				value = vokaes_force_become_subject_infamy
			}
		}
		create_unidirectional_truce = { country = scope:target_country months = 60 }
		hidden_effect = { scope:target_country = { add_liberty_desire = 30 } } # Starts at a higher LD level
		
		power_bloc = {
			add_cohesion_percent = {
				value = scaled_cohesion_cost_subjugation
			}
		}
	}
	
	ai = {
		evaluation_chance = {
			value = 0.025 # AI shouldn't use this very often
		}
		
		will_propose = {
			power_bloc ?= { current_cohesion_percentage >= 0.6 }		
			OR = {
				has_attitude = {
					who = scope:target_country
					attitude = domineering
				}
				power_bloc ?= { current_cohesion_percentage >= 0.8 }						
			}
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_attitude = {
						who = scope:target_country
						attitude = domineering
					}		
					power_bloc ?= { current_cohesion_percentage >= 0.8 }
				}
				scope:target_country = {
					is_country_type = unrecognized
				}
			}		
		}

		propose_score = {								
			value = 10			
		}
	}
}
